text:
Olivia (Demand Gen): Quick ask — we need a compact launch micro-kit for next Thurs' webinar. Deliverables: 1) single-page benchmark one-pager (print/pdf), 2) three social data-cards (1200x1200), 3) email hero banner (600x200) + svg variant, 4) routing diagram for inbound leads (simple two-step flow). Deadline: Wed COB.
Diego (Design): Understood. Visual style: heavy-data, minimal flourish. Any hard metrics we must surface?
Olivia (Demand Gen): Use p50 latency @typical seq, tokens/sec for batching, cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and caching delta. Numbers only from the internal eval sheet I'll drop. No invented comparisons.
Harper (Content): Suggested headline for one-pager: "Inference that pays off". Micro-copy for cards should be tight — 1-line insight + metric.
Nora (Creative Ops): Routing diagram: keep it arrow-based. We want labels for: register -> nurture sequence -> demo ops queue. Also include a tiny conditional: "If lead_score > 70 -> high-priority" (placeholder).
Diego (Design): File formats: layered Figma source, print-ready PDF (one-pager), PNGs for socials at 2x, SVG for hero. Accessibility variant?
Olivia (Demand Gen): Yes — include high-contrast colorway and a grayscale alt for internal slides.
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/newkit/serving-microkit  comment access enabled.
Diego (Design): I'll set up a page called "micro-kit" and pull the tokens legend from the system file.
Harper (Content): Micro-copy options for the email hero: (A) "Cut inference spend without slowing down" (B) "Serve faster, spend smarter" (C) "Practical inference benchmarks, shipped" — pick one.
Olivia (Demand Gen): Go with B. Shorten to "Serve faster, spend smarter."
LegalBot: Reminder: any percentage or cost claim must carry a source line with a linked eval doc and test date. Use conservative language if the test environment is limited.
Nora (Creative Ops): I'll add a small-type footer placeholder for the source line on every asset. Also creating an Asana task for localization later.
Diego (Design): HubSpot mapping snippet please (so I can add as hidden field labels in the Figma notes).
Olivia (Demand Gen): Dropping the snippet here — paste in Figma notes:
```
campaign=serving_microkit
webinar=serving-wins-apr
hidden_field=campaign_source
```
Harper (Content): Also request: include alt-text strings for each social card in the Figma notes. I will draft them.
Diego (Design): Animation? Small SVG sparkline draw for the hero — prototype or static?
Olivia (Demand Gen): Prototype if quick; otherwise static. Prioritize static.
Nora (Creative Ops): Timeline: Diego pushes initial comps Mon AM, review Tues, legal sign-off Wed AM, final assets Wed COB. Sound right?
Diego (Design): Yes. I'll push comps to the Figma link and tag reviewers.
FigmaBot: Comment: https://www.figma.com/file/newkit/serving-microkit?node-id=24:0 — comps uploaded.
Olivia (Demand Gen): Eval doc (internal): https://docs.internal/redwood/evals/serving-microkit-2026 — use only cited rows.
LegalBot: I'll review claims after Diego uploads. Expect ~4-6hr turnaround for small copy. Avoid calling out competitors.
Nora (Creative Ops): Asana note: creating task MARKETING-3122 and assigning Diego + Harper.
AsanaBot: Task created: MARKETING-3122 "Serving micro-kit: one-pager + cards + hero + routing" due 2026-03-31 assigned to @Diego.
Diego (Design): Kicking off now. Will post when ready for review. :rocket:
Olivia (Demand Gen): Thanks team — aim to keep all assets brand-safe and cite the eval link in the footer.
Harper (Content): Drafting alt-text and card micro-copy now; will drop into Figma notes.
Diego (Design): Ping me for any last-minute copy tweaks before I finalize the print pdf.
